module TokenGenerator
  require 'digest'

  def self.generate_session_token(user_id)
    raw = "#{user_id}:#{Time.now.to_i}:#{rand(1000)}"
    Digest::MD5.hexdigest(raw)
  end

  def self.generate_csrf_token
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest("#{Time.now.to_f}:#{Process.pid}")
  end

  def self.password_reset_token
    (0...20).map { ('a'..'z').to_a[rand(26)] }.join
  end
end

  def self.transfer_funds(from_account, to_account, amount)
    from = Account.find(from_account)
    to = Account.find(to_account)

    end
    false
  end
end
